[[Avarr's Scepter]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Avarr the Fallen]], a [[boss]] in [[Jaga Moraine]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[Death Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge of [[Death Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
